Refund_not_showing_up: The user needs help because a refund already promised or issued by a merchant has not appeared in their account or statement.
activate_my_card: The user wants to activate a new or inactive card for use, rather than link it to the app.
age_limit: The user wants to know the minimum age or eligibility rules for a child or young person to have an account.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: The user wants to use or troubleshoot Apple Pay, Google Pay, or a wearable wallet for payments or top-ups.
atm_support: The user wants to know which ATMs accept the card or where to find a compatible ATM.
automatic_top_up: The user wants to set up, manage, or understand limits for automatically adding money to the account.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The user needs help because their balance has not updated after money was transferred into or out of the account by bank transfer.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: The user needs help because a cash or cheque deposit has not been credited to their balance.
beneficiary_not_allowed: The user cannot make a transfer because the intended beneficiary or recipient is being rejected or is not permitted.
cancel_transfer: The user wants to stop, cancel, or correct a transfer that they have already submitted.
card_about_to_expire: The user wants to know what to do about an expired or soon-to-expire card and how its replacement works.
card_acceptance: The user wants to know which merchants or types of establishments will accept their card.
card_arrival: The user needs to locate or track a card that has already been sent but has not arrived as expected.
card_delivery_estimate: The user wants an estimated delivery time or delivery option for a card they are ordering.
card_linking: The user wants to link an existing or new card to the app, or relink a previously disabled card they have recovered.
card_not_working: The user reports that their physical card generally does not work across transactions, rather than one specific payment being declined.
card_payment_fee_charged: The user wants an explanation for an extra fee charged specifically when making a purchase by card.
card_payment_not_recognised: The user wants to identify or dispute a specific card purchase shown on their account that they do not recognize.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The user believes an incorrect currency exchange rate was applied to a purchase made by card.
card_swallowed: The user needs help because an ATM retained their physical card.
cash_withdrawal_charge: The user wants an explanation of a fee charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: The user wants to report or dispute an ATM cash withdrawal that they did not make.
change_pin: The user wants to change their card PIN to a new PIN while the current PIN is still usable.
compromised_card: The user suspects their card or card details have been stolen or used by someone else and needs to secure the card, without focusing on one particular transaction type.
contactless_not_working: The user needs help because the card's contactless payment function is not working.
country_support: The user wants to know whether the bank's accounts or cards are available to residents of a particular country.
declined_card_payment: The user needs help because a specific purchase attempted with their physical card was declined.
declined_cash_withdrawal: The user needs help because an ATM refused their attempt to withdraw cash.
declined_transfer: The user needs help because a money transfer or online transfer was explicitly declined or rejected.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: The user wants to identify or dispute a direct debit that they did not authorize or set up.
disposable_card_limits: The user wants to know the usage, transaction, or creation limits that apply to disposable virtual cards.
edit_personal_details: The user wants to update personal account information such as their address or other profile details.
exchange_charge: The user wants to know about fees or discounts for exchanging currencies, rather than the exchange rate itself.
exchange_rate: The user wants to understand, find, or calculate the bank's currency exchange rate.
exchange_via_app: The user wants to know whether and how currencies can be converted within the app.
extra_charge_on_statement: The user wants an explanation for a small extra charge, commonly £1 or €1, appearing separately on their statement.
failed_transfer: The user needs help because a transfer ended in a failed or error state rather than being explicitly declined or left pending.
fiat_currency_support: The user wants to know which traditional currencies can be held or maintained in the account.
get_disposable_virtual_card: The user wants to understand the purpose of a disposable virtual card or how to obtain one.
get_physical_card: The user wants to find, receive, or view the PIN associated with their physical card.
getting_spare_card: The user wants an additional physical card for themselves or another family member.
getting_virtual_card: The user wants to obtain or locate a standard virtual card, rather than a disposable virtual card.
lost_or_stolen_card: The user needs to block or replace a physical card that has been lost or stolen.
lost_or_stolen_phone: The user needs to secure or regain account access because their phone is lost, stolen, or unavailable.
order_physical_card: The user wants to order a physical card or learn its price and available delivery locations.
passcode_forgotten: The user has forgotten the app or account passcode and wants to recover or reset it.
pending_card_payment: The user needs help because a card purchase remains in pending status and has not completed.
pending_cash_withdrawal: The user needs help because an ATM withdrawal remains pending, whether or not the ATM dispensed the cash.
pending_top_up: The user needs help because an account top-up remains pending and has not completed.
pending_transfer: The user needs help because a money transfer is explicitly shown as pending and has not yet cleared.
pin_blocked: The user needs to unblock their card PIN after too many incorrect PIN attempts.
receiving_money: The user wants to know how another person or an employer can send money or salary directly into their account.
request_refund: The user wants to initiate a refund or cancel a purchase, rather than trace a refund already promised.
reverted_card_payment?: The user needs an explanation because a card payment was reversed and the purchase amount returned to their account.
supported_cards_and_currencies: The user wants to know which external card types and currencies can be used to fund the account by card.
terminate_account: The user wants to close, deactivate, or delete their bank account.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: The user wants to know whether receiving or funding the account through SEPA, SWIFT, or another bank transfer is supported and what it costs.
top_up_by_card_charge: The user wants to know about fees for adding money with a debit, credit, or international card.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: The user wants to know whether and how the account can be funded with cash or a cheque.
top_up_failed: The user needs help because an attempted card top-up failed or was declined without first completing.
top_up_limits: The user wants to know or change the minimum or maximum amount allowed for top-ups.
top_up_reverted: The user needs an explanation because a top-up initially appeared successful but was later reversed or removed.
topping_up_by_card: The user wants instructions or general help for adding money by card, including whether another person's card can be used.
transaction_charged_twice: The user needs help because the same card transaction appears to have been charged more than once.
transfer_fee_charged: The user wants an explanation for a fee charged on a money transfer.
transfer_into_account: The user wants instructions for sending money from another bank account into this account.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The user needs help because a transfer appears to have been sent successfully but the intended recipient has not received it.
transfer_timing: The user wants a general estimate of how long an incoming domestic or international bank transfer should take.
unable_to_verify_identity: The user is trying to complete identity verification but cannot do so because the process is failing or they lack the required information.
verify_my_identity: The user wants instructions on how to complete identity verification and which documents are accepted.
verify_source_of_funds: The user wants to identify or provide evidence of where the money in their account came from.
verify_top_up: The user wants to understand or complete card top-up verification, including finding the required verification code.
virtual_card_not_working: The user needs help because a standard or disposable virtual card is being rejected or otherwise does not work.
visa_or_mastercard: The user wants to know whether their issued card will be Visa or Mastercard or whether they can choose between them.
why_verify_identity: The user wants to know why identity verification is required or what happens if they refuse to complete it.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The user needs help because an ATM dispensed less cash or a different amount than requested or charged.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The user believes an incorrect currency exchange rate was applied to an ATM cash withdrawal.
